reply: Thank you for explaining that you were locked out of your new online checking account two days after opening it, and that the nearest branch is six hours away. We are sorry for the inconvenience this has caused. Your complaint has been logged for review by the account services team, including whether the verification can be completed without a branch visit. Please review your account agreement for the identity verification steps it describes, and keep a note of your calls. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for letting us know that your applications for a new checking account have been declined several times, even though you have never taken a loan. We understand how confusing this is. Your complaint has been logged for review by the account opening team. You can ask which consumer report was used for the decision and request a free copy of it to check for errors. If a regular account is not available, you may also ask about a second-chance account. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your account was closed after checks from a client you now believe was a scammer were returned. We are sorry you were targeted in this way. Your complaint has been logged for review by the account services team, including your request about the account and your banking record. Please keep copies of your messages with the client and the returned check notices, and consider reporting the scam to the Federal Trade Commission. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your account was restricted after a Treasury check you deposited for a friend cleared, and that the verification step has not worked. We understand how stressful it is to be without access to your funds. Your complaint has been logged for review by the account services team. Please ask the bank to explain in writing what information it still needs and how long holds on large deposits can last, and keep records of each call. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that unauthorized charges kept appearing on your account, that some of your claims were denied, and that the account was then closed. We are sorry for the late fees and stress this has caused. Your complaint has been logged for review by the disputes team, including the denied claims. Please list each unauthorized transaction with its date and amount, and keep copies of the proof you already sent. Reporting unauthorized electronic transfers promptly helps protect your rights. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that a mattress shown as delivered never arrived, and that both the merchant and your bank denied your claims without explaining why. We understand how frustrating the repeated transfers between agents have been. Your complaint has been logged for review by the disputes team. Please ask the bank in writing for the reason behind its decision and the information it relied on, and keep your police report and delivery records together. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for telling us that you learned of an account opened in your name only when you were served court papers. We understand how worrying this is. Your complaint has been logged for review by the fraud team. Please review your statements and your free credit reports from each of the three major credit bureaus for other accounts you do not recognize, and keep copies of the court papers. Reporting the identity theft promptly will support the review. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that two transactions you did not authorize were found on your statement and that your dispute was denied. We understand your frustration with being told the transactions were yours. Your complaint has been logged for review by the disputes team. Please send a written request that names each transaction and asks for the reasons for the decision, and let the bank know right away that your card is missing so later transfers are blocked. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for telling us that your account was locked while you were moving $500.00 to another bank, and that you still cannot reach your money after sending the verification document. We understand how difficult this is. Your complaint has been logged for review by the account services team. Please keep a copy of the verification form you returned and a record of each contact, and ask for written confirmation of what is still needed to restore access. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that funds from a $140.00 check you deposited last year have been held for nearly a year, even though the paying bank confirmed the check was paid. We are sorry this is still unresolved. Your complaint has been logged for review by the deposit operations team. Please keep the written confirmation from the paying bank and a record of your requests, and ask for a written explanation of why the funds are still held. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you were charged several overdraft fees even though you had enough money when the transactions were authorized. Your complaint has been logged for review by the account services team, which will look at the posting dates of the charges and credits involved. Please list the dates and amounts of the fees and keep your statements. You may also want to check whether you are opted in to overdraft coverage for debit card and ATM transactions. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for telling us that your direct deposits and other incoming transfers have not reached your checking account since the service issue began. We understand how hard it is to wait for money you need. Your complaint has been logged for review by the deposit operations team. Please keep the confirmations from the payers showing when each payment was sent, and check the bank's direct deposit availability policy for your account. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you were charged multiple overdraft fees although your balance was sufficient when the transactions were authorized. We understand your concern about how charges and credits were posted. Your complaint has been logged for review by the account services team. Please note the dates and amounts of each fee and keep your statements for those periods. You can also check your overdraft settings, because declining coverage for debit card and ATM transactions affects which fees can be charged. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for telling us about the overdraft fees charged on your account even though funds were available when the transactions were authorized. Your complaint has been logged for review by the account services team, which will look at how the charges and credits were posted. To help the review, please list each fee with its date and keep your statements for the months involved. You may also want to confirm whether you are opted in to overdraft coverage. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that overdraft fees were charged on your account despite sufficient funds when the transactions were authorized. We understand why you want the posting of these transactions looked at. Your complaint has been logged for review by the account services team. Please keep your statements and a list of the fee dates and amounts so the review can match them to each transaction. You can also check your overdraft coverage settings for debit card and ATM use. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for telling us that your direct deposit has not arrived because of the outage, and that you have not been able to reach customer service. We are sorry for the hardship this delay is causing your family. Your complaint has been logged for review by the deposit operations team. Please keep any outage notices you received and the confirmation from your employer that the deposit was sent. During an outage, money in an insured account remains protected. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your direct deposit from your employer and other incoming deposits have not been credited because of technical issues. We understand the concern this causes. Your complaint has been logged for review by the deposit operations team. Please keep your employer's confirmation of the payment date and amount, along with any notices you received about the issue. You can also ask the bank when electronically deposited funds will be made available to you. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for telling us that scheduled direct deposits have not been released during the technical issue, over a holiday weekend, and that wait times have been very long. We are sorry for the strain this is putting on you. Your complaint has been logged for review by the deposit operations team. Please keep your employer's payment confirmation and ask about the direct deposit availability policy for your account, since payroll deposits are generally due by the next business day. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that overdraft fees were assessed on your account although you had enough money when the transactions were authorized. Your complaint has been logged for review by the account services team, which will look at the timing of the charges and credits that were posted. Please gather the statements that show each fee and the related transactions. You may also want to review your overdraft settings for debit card and ATM transactions. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for telling us about the overdraft fees charged on your account even though your balance covered the transactions when they were authorized. We understand why you want these fees looked at. Your complaint has been logged for review by the account services team. Please list each fee with its date and amount, and keep your statements so the review can match them to the posted transactions. You can also check whether you are opted in to overdraft coverage. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that the branch is requiring a receipt for a phone cleaning service before it will update your number and account after the hacking incident. We understand this is a cost you cannot cover right now. Your complaint has been logged for review by the account services team. Please ask the branch to show you in writing the policy behind this requirement. Contact the bank only through a number you trust, never through links in messages. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for telling us about the debit card transactions you did not authorize and that you reported them to your bank right away. We are sorry you have bills to pay while you wait. Your complaint has been logged for review by the disputes team. Please keep a record of when you reported the transactions and to whom, and ask the bank whether a provisional credit applies while it investigates. Prompt reporting of unauthorized electronic transfers helps protect your rights. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining the charges you disputed after your car was broken into, and that your card was later frozen without an explanation. We are sorry this happened when you needed the money for your children. Your complaint has been logged for review by the account services team. Please keep your police report and any emails from the bank, and ask in writing why the card was frozen and what is needed to release the funds. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that the ATM froze while counting your cash deposit, printed a receipt, and that your claim was later closed as no deposit made. We understand how upsetting this is. Your complaint has been logged for review by the deposit operations team. Please keep the receipt the ATM printed and a record of your calls, and if the bank does not own the ATM, contact the ATM owner as well. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that items posted after you emptied your account brought it to a negative balance, and that fees continue while you cannot see your balance or close the account. We are sorry this has been so difficult. Your complaint has been logged for review by the account services team. Please ask in writing for a full statement of the current balance and fees, and keep the closure letter. A closed account with a negative balance can affect future account applications. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for telling us that your new account was flagged for fraud when you made a withdrawal, and that you have not been told why. We understand how upsetting it is to lose access to your funds. Your complaint has been logged for review by the account services team, including your concerns about how you were treated. Please ask in writing what documents are needed to remove the restriction, and keep copies of what you provide. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for letting us know that you received checks and a debit card for an account you did not request, even though your credit is frozen. We understand how alarming this is. Your complaint has been logged for review by the fraud team, including how the account was opened. Please ask for written confirmation that the account has been closed, and keep your security freeze in place at all three credit bureaus. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your new account was closed for suspected fraud and that your paycheck funds are being held. We understand how hard it is to pay bills without access to your money. Your complaint has been logged for review by the account services team. Please ask in writing how and when the remaining balance will be returned to you, and keep records of your deposits and calls. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for telling us that your payroll check deposit has been withheld after the account was closed, even though you completed the verification. We are sorry this has gone on so long. Your complaint has been logged for review by the deposit operations team. Please keep a copy of the check and your verification confirmation, and ask in writing when and how the funds will be released to you. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for telling us that someone opened a checking account in your name and that you have not received a response to your identity theft report. We understand how stressful this is. Your complaint has been logged for review by the fraud team. Please keep a copy of your Identity Theft Report and supporting documents, and contact the security or fraud department of each affected institution. Closing affected accounts quickly can limit further harm. You will receive an update once the review is complete.
